notablePrerequisites:
Rhys does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G/W}.
description:
Activate any number of mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G/W}.
Activate Rhys' first ability by paying {2}{G/W} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
